brief:
Israeli occupation forces released six prisoners from Gaza on Sunday, Shehab Wire reported. The detainees were freed in what appears to be part of an ongoing exchange process between Israel and Palestinian armed groups operating in the enclave.

Officials did not immediately provide the names of those released or disclose further details about the circumstances of their detention or the conditions of their release.
